text: INT. OFFICE /DRESSING ROOM- DIANE’S OFFICE /DRESS SHOP- DAY1
location: INT OFFICE /DRESSING ROOM- DIANE’S OFFICE /DRESS SHOP

text: DIANE ELLIS (24) sits at her desk drawing the draft of a table setting, surrounded by wedding catalogues and different wedding plans. Her phone rings, it’s JEFFREY LEVINE(around 25). DIANE Hi babe, how was your tux fitting? JEFFREYHi sweetie, Thank you for choosing the tux for me. I wish you could’ve come with me to try it on today. DIANEHave you forgotten that I am a professional wedding planner? After working for so many years, I finally have the opportunity to design my own wedding. I am so happy! JEFFREYAnd I’m so happy to be your customer. (scrolling mobile screen) I’m gonna send some videos over to you like you asked- DIANEOh! I see your message. Diane opens the message from Jeffrey. JEFFREYNo, wait, (A bit panic) just delete that message, I didn’t mean to send that- Jeffrey’s voice fades out. All Diane can see and hear is the video of Jeffrey in a dressing room dressed in a sharp tuxedo, passionately kisses ALLISON ELLIS(Diane’s half sister 21), who’s halfway out of her wedding dress. Their hands are all over each other. DIANE (OS)My fiancé cheated on me! With my half sister! On the day before our wedding!
She threw her phone to the ground in despair, covering her face and crying bitterly.
INT. DIANE’S OFFICE- DAY2 2

Diane covers her face and cries bitterly with the phone on the ground. JEFFREY (VO)Diane, You’re at work, right? I’ll be there soon. Let’s talk about this. Diane picks up the phone and ends the call, her face etches with pain and sorrow. Wiping away her tears, she take a deep breath, steadied herself, and turns to leave.
EXT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY3 3

Diane storms out of the office building. Jeffrey gets out of his BMW and runs up to her. JEFFREYDiane, listen. It was an accident. DIANEAn accident? Your pants accidentally fell, and my sister accidentally ended up in your lap? Jeffrey grabs her chin aggressively. He leans in with a threat. JEFFREYWatch your mouth! He forcefully kisses Diane's mouth. Diane breaks free. JEFFREY(CONT’D)Might I remind you that after today, I will be your husband? And with the Astor Group investing in my family, you’d better be smart and play along. DIANENo, the wedding is off. I have proof that you cheated on me. She waves her phone in his face.

JEFFREYHow dare you? Do I need to remind you that without marrying me, you won't see a dime of your late mother's shares? DIANEI'll get married, just not to you. Jeffrey advances towards Diane, pinning her against his car. She struggles. JEFFREYCome on, be a good girl. You are not the one who make the decisions, not now, not ever. DIANEI will not marry a cheating scumbag! Never! Diane pulls off her engagement ring and throws it at Jeffrey.
EXT. STREET - DAY4 4

Diane marches down the street furiously. When she is crossing the street, a car rushes towards her. Diane does not have time to dodge and her eyes widened in fear. Just when Diane is about to be hit, a tall and strong man, LIAM ASTOR (26) rushes over and pulls her from the front of the car to the side of the street. Before Diane can react, Liam pushes Diane against the wall, hugs her tightly in his arms and lowers his head and kisses her deeply. Two STRANGERS rush past, on the hunt for someone. STRANGER 1I saw him go this way... STRANGER 2We need to catch him! Once Liam realizes he's in the clear, their lips separate. LIAM(playfully)My Guardian Angel...you've just saved my life.

DIANEHi, handsome, I’m pretty sure you’re the one who saved me just now. LIAMHaha, wanna return the favor? DIANE(flirty)What? You want me for the night? LIAM(grinning)Just for the night? DIANE How about till death do us part?
EXT. ENTRANCE OF CITY HALL - DAY5 5

Diane and Liam walk out of City Hall. She holds Liam's hand in one hand, and their marriage certificate in the other. Diane’s face is full of surprise. DIANEI can't believe we're married. LIAMWe’ve only known each other for a few hours, it’s crazy! Diane studies the certificate. We see Diane Ellis's name. Then Liam's name. Last name: Astor. DIANE (OS)Liam... what a cute name! Diane seems to remember something and quickly closed the document without even glancing at it. DIANE(CONT’D)I've gotta go. You be good, okay? LIAMI didn't think my wifey would leave me this fast. Where are you heading to?

DIANEWell, I gotta settle things with my ex-fiancé. SPLIT SCREEN - INT./EXT. OFFICE/ENTRANCE OF CITY HALL - DAY 46 Liam watches Diane head into a taxi. He pulls out his phone to call his assistant CAL GARRISON (20s). CALBoss, you alright? You should’ve waited for me to pick you up! LIAMIt was just two guys, I can take care of myself. Did you figure out who sent them after me? CALI’m working on it. Whoever hired them covered up their tracks pretty well. Where are you now? I’ll go pick you up. LIAMNah, I'll stay with my wife.

The crowd erupts in chatter. GUEST1Excuse me, what did she say? GUEST2Shit is going down. Mr. Ellis grits his teeth. He rushes onto the stage and slaps Diane. Diane covers her face sadly. There is another commotion among the crowd. MR. ELLISHave you completely lost your mind? DIANEDad, I'm sorry to disappoint you, but you don't understand what happened to me- Mrs. Levine emerges. Her trembling finger points at Diane. MRS. LEVINEHow dare you break off an engagement with my son! You were never even good enough. DIANESomeday when you see how many different girls show up to spit on Jeffrey's grave, you'll understand. MRS. LEVINEYou dare speak about my son like this? Who do you think you are?! JEFFREYApologize to my mother, Diane. Stop making a fuss. Allison comes over and touches Diane's cheek with a smirk. ALLISONStop acting like a child! You need to accept the fact that you can’t always get what you want.
I should be the one saying this to you.

(Pauses, with a small smile) By the way, congrats—you’re going to be a big star. At this moment, the guests' phones all ring with notifications of incoming messages. Everyone lower their heads to look at their phones, and shocks. The video (CU) of Jefferey and Allison having an affair appears on everyone's phone. The sound of moaning continues. Allison see her phone and covers her mouth.
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY7 7

The wedding hall is decorated with beautiful flower arrangements and the wedding is in full swing. 20 Guests are seated and chatting away. At the altar, Jeffrey Levine glances over at the guest , who are starting to look impatient. He motions for them to keep playing. MR. ELLISAny word from Diane? NANCYI’ve already tried calling her several times, but nothing yet. Along the front row of chairs, NANCY( Allison's mom, in 50’s) shares an impatient glance with Allison who is wearing a ，bridesmaid's dress as she surveys the room behind her.

MR. ELLISHow are we supposed to explain this to the Levine’s? NANCYOh darling, we spoiled her. She’s become so disrespectful, even running late on her own wedding day. Nancy and Allison exchange knowing smiles. ALLISONPoor Diane. She must be weeping in the dump where she belongs. NANCY(lower her voice)We’ll make sure that you’re one who Jeffrey marries, not Diane. GUEST 1 (O.S.)The bride has arrived! ALLISONShe’s here?? Allison averts her gaze to the large doors of the WEDDING HALL. Everyone else's eyes follow. The doors swing open and Diane emerges in her wedding dress.
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY8 8

The doors swing open and Diane emerges in her wedding dress. GUEST1Look at the lucky girl! Thanks to our upcoming union with the Astor Group, the Levine name is at its peak. GUEST2Diane is also a good match. I heard that she planned her own wedding and designed her own wedding dress. Allison's smile fades. Mr. Ellis, Nancy and Mrs. Levine walk up to Diane.

MR. ELLISMy daughter, you finally decided to show up and do one thing right for a change. MRS. LEVINEMarrying into our family comes with a lot of responsibility. Are you prepared to take it on? Just as Diane is about to speak, Jeffrey and Allison approach. JEFFREYI knew you'd come around. DIANEToday is my big day, how could I miss it? (beat, look at Allison)My dear sister, I just saw you yesterday, and I didn't expect you to come today. ALLISON(a little awkwardly)Sis, don’t you remember? I’m your bridesmaid. Diane sneers. Allison avoids her gaze. Jeffrey leans in to whisper in Diane's ear. JEFFREYYou better stop being so stubborn. From now on, I won’t be as forgiving. Jeffrey motions for the wedding to begin. All of the guests sit down and the chatter settles. Mr. Ellis who is Diane’s father, holds her hand and walks slowly forward. When he is about to give Diane’s hand to Jefferey, Diane break free from Jefferey's hand and walks to the center of the stage. All the guests look surprised. Diane faces the guests. DIANEAttention everyone! Thank you all for coming today but I am here to announce that my wedding to Jeffrey Levine is cancelled!
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY9 9

The video (CU) of Jefferey and Allison having an affair appears on everyone's phone. The sound of moaning continues. The guests watch in complete shock. GUEST 1Oh my god, look at these videos! GUEST 2How obscene! Allison looks mortified. ALLISONNo... No... But we hear Allison moan, "Yes, yes."(in the video) MR. LEVINEEnough! Nancy angrily walks over and slaps Diane. NANCYAfter everything we’ve done for you, you’ve brought us nothing but shame! DIANEGo ahead and let your precious daughter take my place as the bride...she's earned it, after all. Jeffrey grabs Diane's wrist.

JEFFREYHoney, I like when you’re being a little brat, but even my patience has its limits! Jeffrey turns to the guests and makes an announcement. JEFFREY(CONT’D)I apologize to everyone for the misunderstanding just now. Our wedding will go on. Jeffrey grabbed Diane’s arm and tried to drag her back to the stage. Diane slaps him on he face. DIANEDon't touch me! I'm not your fiancée anymore! JEFFREY(angrily)Take her back home, now! Two BODYGUARD rushes over grabbing Diane and ushers her away in seconds. LIAM (V.O.)NO! Let go of her! Everyone looks in the direction of the voice and sees Liam stride into the wedding hall.
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY10 10

Liam walks in with a stern expression. He walks over to Diane and grabs the bodyguard's wrist. The bodyguard winces and falls back. LIAMDiane, are you okay? DIANEWhat are you doing here? Jefferey takes a step forward and stands in front of Diane. JEFFREY(to Liam)Who let this filth in?

LIAM(to the guards)Take your hands off my wife! The guests all gasp. GUEST1Who is the real groom? GUEST 2I feel like my brain is exploding. Jeffrey is in disbelief. JEFFREYWife?! The whole city knows Diane is my fiancée. You're delusional. DIANE(grabbing Liam's arm)Don’t talk to my husband like that! JEFFREYHusband? Diane, you didn't need to hire someone to embarrass both of our families. DIANEJeffrey, listen, he is genuinely my husband. Diane goes over to Liam and hold his hand. Jeffrey slowly looks Liam up with a sneer. JEFFREYWhy would you rather marry this nobody over me? DIANEMy husband is a thousand times more of a man than you'll ever be. JEFFREYAre you fucking insane?! Just because I slept with your sister? Come on, I just made a mistake that all men make. Liam grabs Jeffrey by his collar with a threatening glare. LIAMYou don't deserve her.

Jeffrey shoves Liam off him and shoots Liam a sneer. JEFFREYIs that so? You look like nothing more than low-class trash yourself. You think marrying a woman I cast aside somehow makes you my equal? Liam punches Jeffrey's face instantly. Jeffrey reels back. His nose starts bleeding. JEFFREY(CONT’D)Do you know who I am? I'm Jeffrey Levine of the Levine family! Leave now or I'll make sure you are gone for good. LIAMThe Levine family? Is that supposed to mean something to me? JEFFREYHow dare you speak to me like that? Mr. Astor is investing a ton of money into my company. By disrespecting me, you're disgracing him! LIAMWhat a coincidence! You want to cooperate with the Astor company, right? JEFFREYThat's right, you may not even be qualified to be the janitor of a huge company like Astor. LIAMYou know what? I am Liam Astor himself.
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY11 11
You know what? I am Liam Astor himself. The Mr. Astor who's been financing you!
The room is silent for a moment, then bursts into laughter.

JEFFREYBillionaires like Liam Astor would never go out alone without an entourage or bodyguards. NANCYLook at his wrinkled suit. He must have bought it from a thrift store. ALLISONHow ridiculous!! Mr. Astor is surrounded by beautiful women. (circle around Diane)Would he waste his time on a girl like Diane who has no looks or figure? JEFFREYYou really think we would believe that you're Liam Astor? Arrest that impostor! The two bodyguards motion to grab Liam. LIAMGo on, try and lay a hand on me. JEFFREYYou are dead meat. Cal Garrison, Liam Astor's personal assistant is bringing me a document. He will be here soon to sort this out. Shock amongst the guests. Suddenly all eyes on Mr. Levine. GUEST 1Mr. Levine, if Mr. Astor's assistant shows up, that'll solidify your partnership. GUEST 2Don't forget about us when your business takes off in the future! Diane tugs on Liam's sleeve and leans in. DIANEI'll distract the bodyguards if you sneak out that way. LIAMWhy would I leave?

DIANEMr. Astor is ruthless. If he finds out you're impersonating him, who knows what he'll do? This is my mess. Don't let me drag you down. LIAMYou're my wife. We face everything together now. JEFFREYHow sweet. I can't wait to expose you and your lies. BODYGUARDMr. Cal Garrison is here! The doors swing open and Cal enters. The Levine family rushes over to greet him. MR. LEVINEMr. Garrison, what an honor to have you here. JEFFREYThank you for solidifying our partnership. I can't wait to personally thank Mr. Astor. Cal nods and sees Liam. His eyes widen. CALMr. Astor?

MR. LEVINEYeah! When I called his office, the receptionist told me Mr. Astor hadn't returned yet. JEFFREYNone of us know what Mr. Astor and his assistant look like. Those men were just tricking us! NANCYThe real Mr. Astor would never go for Diane. JEFFREYOnce the real Mr. Astor finds out, he'll make them both pay.
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY12 12
The room is stunned to silence. MR. ELLISMr. Astor is here? Cal steps forward, bowing to Liam. CALBoss, I didn’t know you would be here. The Levine family approaches, Jeffrey points at Liam.

JEFFREYNo, this man is an impostor! CALMr. Astor is Mr. Astor, there is no impostor here. Diane looks at Liam, just as shocked as the rest. DIANEI can’t believe it. You can't be..serious... Mr. Astor is a billionaire. Liam looks at the Levine family. LIAMYou don't deserve a partnership with the Astor Group. Our joint venture is over, effective immediately. MR. LEVINEMr. Astor, please, this was all a misunderstanding. Can we discuss this further? JEFFREYIs he really Mr. Astor? ALLISONAnd Diane is Mr. Astor‘s wife? Diane is shocked too. She opened her mouth to say something, but Liam stops her. LIAMDon't waste more time talking to them, let’s go! Liam shoves Mr. Levine aside, then grabs Diane's hand and pulls her along as they exit. Cal follows closely behind. The guests begin filing out. JEFFREYNo, no. This isn’t right. Wasn’t Mr. Astor supposed to be out of town?
INT. ELLIS HOUSE LIVING ROOM-DAY13 13

Mr. Ellis slams his fist hard against the table.Allison and Nancy are standing around. Mr. Ellis turns to his ASSISTANT. MR. ELLISMake a public statement. I, Mr. Ellis, officially disown Diane Ellis. ALLISONDad, I support your decision, this will stop her from getting the inheritance her mom left behind, right? That's a lot of money, 30 million dollars. MR. ELLISNo, we can't stop her. The contract says she can get it as long as she gets married. No other conditions are required. Mr. Ellis storms off. Allison stomps her foot hard. ALLISONIt really pisses me off that she brought shame upon me and my entire family, and she’s getting away with it unscathed. Nancy looks at Allison with a triumphant smile.
NANCYAllison, don't worry. You will be much wealthier if you marry Jeffrey. Now that Diane is done, it's your time to strike. ALLISON(smiling)Mrs. Jeffrey Levine, here I come.
INT. PIZZA STORE - DAY14 14

Diane, Liam, and Cal sit in a booth at a small pizza store. DIANEThat was amazing! How did you think to pose as Mr. Astor? You were so convincing.(to Cal)And you! Oscar worthy performance. Cal has an awkward expression. Liam looks at Diane gently. LIAM(to Diane)You are my savior. For you, I could do anything Liam’s face turns to Cal. LIAM(CONT’D)(to Cal)Did you prepare what I asked for? Cal hands a big box to Liam. Liam hands the box over to Diane. DIANEWhat did I do to deserve this? LIAMDiane, you're my wife now. Of course you deserve this. Diane opens the box to find a sparkling diamond necklace and earrings. DIANELiam, you shouldn’t have!

LIAMDo you like it? Diane takes the necklace and earrings in her hands and strokes it gently. DIANEI love it. Thank you!(beat, V.O.) How could he afford such expensive jewelry? This must be an knockoff!
INT. PIZZA STORE - DAY15 15

DIANE(with a wink)Sure, “Mr. Astor”. Once our arrangement is through and we separate, I'll be sure to pay you back. LIAMWhat do you mean "once our arrangement is through"? DIANEI saved you that day, and then you agreed to a fake marriage with me to get revenge on my cheating jerk ex-boyfriend, and we did it, that was our deal! LIAMI don't want this to be so transactional. DIANEMe either. But the fact is, it’s you who saved me that day, and you helped me so much today, of course I have to repay you. Then we can part ways and move on with our lives. LIAMWhat if I don't want your money?

DIANEThen what do you want? Tell me if there’s anything you want and I'll see how I can help. LIAMAnything? Liam leans in close to Diane. He whispers in her ear-- LIAM(CONT’D)What if... I just want... you. Diane's heart quickens at his words. They're about to kiss until Diane's phone rings. She picks up. It's SALLY. SALLY (V.O.)Hey, just thought you should know that you’re fired! Come gather your things before we toss them out. Sally hangs up. Diane stares at her phone, confused and shocked.
INT. OFFICE - DAY16 16

Diane strides through the office. Her COLLEAGUES look away as she passes. Sally spots Diane and approaches with a smirk. SALLYYou really thought we’d keep you around after you ruined your own million-dollar wedding and your ex-boyfriend's family refused to pay for it? More colleagues gather, their eyes darting between Diane and Sally, sensing the escalating drama. DIANEIf the client doesn't pay, you can sue him. You should know that I am not the one who ruined the wedding. I am also a victim.

SALLYDo you still feel wronged? You have offended the LEVINE family. Now your father has disowned you. Our company was implicated and we’ve lost more clients. Did you know that? DIANEMy job has nothing to with my family or the Levine family. You can't fire me for these unwarranted reasons! SALLYWake up, princess. The company didn't ask you to pay compensation. We’re already doing you a favor. The least you could do is say thank you and get out as fast as you can. MJI know you, Sally. You just wanna fire Diane so you can slap your name onto all on her designs, just like you did all those times before, right? Sally steps forward furiously, raising her hand as if to slap MJ. Diane grabs Sally‘s arm in the air.
Who is making a scene here? Go back to work.

The 4 colleagues go back to their desk. The Director goes to Diane. DIRECTOR (O.S.)(CONT’D)Diane Ellis? Come to my office, right now! Sally sneers and lowers her hand. SALLYI don’t even need to do anything. Our director will tear you apart.
INT. OFFICE - DIRECTOR’S OFFICE - DAY17 17

Diane follows the director, entering the director’s office. DIRECTORClose the door, Ms. Ellis. DIANESir, if I’m getting fired- DIRECTORMs. Ellis, we have reps from the Astor Group upstairs. They're about to invest serious money into this company. I can’t afford to have my coordinators making a scene where everyone can see them. DIANEPlease, let me explain- DIRECTORYou don’t need to explain anything to me. You will not be fired. I know you are a great wedding planner. I also know that Sally framed you. I will be on your side. DIANEWill you? The Director stands up and approaches Diane with a leer. DIRECTOR reaches out his hand to grab Diane’s hand. Diane pulls her hand back. DIRECTORMy sweetheart, I would do anything for you. Diane suspects that she misheard him. Before she can react, the Director rushes over and hugs her, searching for her lips. DIANEStop, stop! The director covers Diane’s mouth to prevent her from making any sound. Diane struggles to break free. She glares at the director angrily.
DIRECTORYou, little brat, if you can marry a bum like your husband, why not play with me?
INT. AT THE DOOR OF THE DIRECTOR’S OFFICE - DAY20
location: INT AT THE DOOR OF THE DIRECTOR’S OFFICE

text: DIANEPresident, I'll leave but not before the Director’s actions are accounted for. PRESIDENTWhat did you do to Ms. Ellis? DIRECTORI did nothing, she came onto me- SALLYIt’s true, I saw it all happen- PRESIDENTQuiet! (beat, go over to Diane)The Astor Enterprise has seen your portfolio and they’re very impressed with your work. They will only agree to sign the deal with you. SALLYHow could they only want her? PRESIDENTThey’re waiting upstairs now, if you’re ready to sign the deal with them. DIANEI'll go, but the Director was trying to blackmail me into sleeping with him to keep my job. The President turns to a nervous Director immediately. PRESIDENTYou're fired!

The frightened Director steps forward to beg for mercy. DIRECTOR(pleading)Please, I need this job. You know who'll come after me if I can't keep up my payments... PRESIDENT(cutting him off)Your gambling addiction is not my problem. Besides, whether you stay or go is not up to me. Director's eyes dart around, realizing that Diane holds the power in the room. He quickly kneels before Diane. DIRECTORDiane...Miss Ellis, please...be the bigger person and forgive me. It's all my fault! DIANEYou want my forgiveness? Director nods frantically. He nods again, eagerly, his pride shattered completely. DIANE(CONT’D)(CONT'D)Well, don’t hold your breath! Diane smiles. The two walk out, leaving the Director still kneeling on the floor. Sally, displeased, kicks the Director as she passes by.
INT. OFFICE - DIRECTOR’S OFFICE - DAY18 18
Diane rears back and slaps the Director across the face. DIANEHow do you like that? DIRECTORYou little bitch! Diane leaves the director’s office with the Director hot on her heels.
INT. AT THE DOOR OF THE DIRECTOR’S OFFICE - DAY19
location: INT AT THE DOOR OF THE DIRECTOR’S OFFICE

text: Diane and the director run into Sally at the door. SALLYI saw everything! You were trying to seduce the director to keep your job! How desperate can you get? Two other employees are watching and whispering to each other. The Director takes Sally’s words in stride. DIRECTORThat’s exactly what she was doing. I have to say, I’m appalled by your behavior in the workplace. DIANEI've stayed quiet about your disgusting harassment at this company for too long! It's about time I put an end to this! DIRECTORHarassment? You think anyone's gonna believe a disgruntled employee like you? You are nothing. DIANEEveryone has either seen it or experienced it.

We are not here to please you whenever the urge arises. You're a damn pig! DIRECTORI'll throw you out of here with my own two hands. I won't stand any backtalk from a lowlife like you. COLLEAGUE 1Just get out of here! You're just stirring up trouble at this point. COLLEAGUE 2Nobody cares about you or your “harassment”. SALLYI don't think you have anyone on your side here. You are alone, you always have been. MJShe isn't alone, and she isn’t nothing, her designs have launched so many successful brands, the company owes her a lot! DIANEMJ, don't waste your energy with these kinds of people, I will collect evidence and let the authorities handle this! PRESIDENT (O.S.)What's going on here? Hearing a sound behind him, Director turns around fearfully at the sight of PRESIDENT. DIRECTORP...President, weren't you in a meeting with the Astor Group reps? The Director and Sally exchange glances. DIRECTOR(CONT’D)Diane! Your tantrum has caused such a ruckus, even the President has come down! The President slaps director across the face viciously.
PRESIDENT(angry rebuke)Shut up! The other employees behind them look shocked. PRESIDENT(CONT’D)Miss Ellis, are you alright?
INT. MEETING ROOM - DAY21 21
President enters the meeting room, bowing his head nervously. PRESIDENTMr. Astor, I've taken care of everything. I hope it meets your satisfaction.
INT. MEETING ROOM - DAY22 22
Liam approaches President.

LIAMIf I ever hear of Diane being mistreated again, I'll have to bankrupt this place and sell it for scraps. The president's face pales as he fumbles to respond. PRESIDENTYou have my word that it won't happen again. Miss Ellis is waiting outside to sign the contract. Liam chuckles to himself, amused by the president's fear. LIAMGreat, give us the room and then send her in.
INT. CORRIDOR - DAY23 23

The President grabs Diane's arm. PRESIDENT(worried)Miss Ellis, good luck, don't mess this up. The man inside is extremely important. DIANE(raising an eyebrow)Just how important is he? PRESIDENTHe's none other than the CEO of Astor Enterprise, Liam Astor. DIANEMr. Astor?! PRESIDENTYes! He specifically asked for you. DIANE(still processing)Why me? PRESIDENTI have no idea what it is about you that Mr. Astor is interested in. But he's here for you.
Diane forces an awkward smile as she takes a deep breath. She straightens her posture, steels her nerves, and then walks toward the meeting room.
INT. MEETING ROOM - DAY24 24

Diane walks into the meeting room, peering around. Liam sits in the shadows with his head turned away, preventing Diane from seeing his face clearly. LIAM(Intentionally changing his voice)Diane Ellis, right? DIANE(nervous)Yes sir. Are you...President Astor? LIAM(coldly)Who I am is not important. Just sign the papers. Diane picks up the contract on the table and signs it quickly while sneaking a glance at Liam. DIANEI'll strive to do my best for the Astor Group, Sir. LIAMUmm, I'm counting on you. Diane smiles, puts down the contract, and turns to leave. LIAM(CONT’D)I heard you just planned your own wedding. I saw the design and I like it very much. DIANE(without turning)Yes, I spent a year carefully designing every detail, but unfortunately everything was ruined. LIAMCan I have you design my wedding?
DIANEMy pleasure. Your bride must be one lucky girl. LIAMYes, she has no idea just how much I love her. Liam turns his chair in the dark. Diane’s eyes widen in surprise.
INT. MEETING ROOM - DAY25 25

Liam turns his chair in the dark. Diane’s eyes widen in surprise. She suddenly feels a bit familiar with the face in the darkness, which makes her very nervous. DIANE(soft, with a hint of fear)Mr. Astor, Sir, if there is nothing else, I will leave first. Liam motions to stop her but Diane flees in panic.
INT. DIANE'S APARTMENT - BEDROOM - NIGHT39

She is laying on the bed, and Liam sits beside her with a glass of water. LIAMAre you feeling better now? Here, drink this and get some rest. DIANEYou saved me again. My Guardian Angel. I need to pay you back properly this time. LIAM(confused)What do you mean...? DIANE(playfully)We need to make this a real marriage. LIAMDiane, we're already husband and wife... Before Liam could finish his sentence, Diane pushes him down to the bed and kisses him deeply. Liam is pleasantly surprised, a smile spreading across his face soon. LIAM(CONT’D)(laughing)Just don't say I took advantage of you in the morning. DIANE(grinning)You're my husband. I promise I won't run away in the morning. Liam’s body inches closer to Diane's, the atmosphere shifting. DIANE(CONT’D)(soft moan)Liam... Liam kisses Diane again, they embrace passionately. We see the two go all in for the first time.

character: INT. DIANE'S APARTMENT - BEDROOM - DAY NEXT MORNING40
text: Diane and Liam are lying in bed. Diane wakes up and sits up, holding her waist.
DIANE(yells in pain)Ow... What happened last night? Liam yawns. LIAM(teasing)You really don't remember? DIANEDon't worry. I remember it all. The bad...(Diane eyes Liam'sbody, smiling)And the good.
INT. OFFICE - ENTRANCE - DAY26 26

Diane hurries down the entrance, her heart pounding in her chest. Suddenly, MJ darts over and links arms with her. MJAre you okay? DIANEI'm doing alright. MJ(playful)How is Mr. Astor then? DIANE(agitated)I don't know why everyone idolizes him-a gentleman who’s rich beyond our understanding. MJMr. Astor is incredibly wealthy and influential. Even the President of the United States has met with him.

DIANE(flatly)Money and power can't buy you everything. MJ(mocking)Apparently sex doesn't either. Sally thought she was so slick, screwing the boss to get ahead. Karma is a goddess. DIANESally was cheated by the director, the poor thing. I feel sorry for her. MJPeople like that aren’t worth your pity. She chose to sell her body, so she should pay for it. SALLY (V.O.)Bitch, what are you saying about me behind my back? You have no right to judge me! Sally appears from behind Diane, looking angry.
